This file is the manual. IMPORT.md is generated from it, so what you copy here is exactly what was tested.
Copy the blocks below in order. Each one is fenced:
<!-- dq:block id="..." action="..." --> ... copy from here to the closing fence ... <!-- dq:endblock -->
Only the block marked action="edit" is yours to change. The one marked copy-verbatim records your data; editing it loses data silently.
THE ONE RULE THAT BREAKS DATA The question block and the capture block must be on the SAME PAGE, in that order, with no <suspend/> between them. A question can only write fields the browser has rendered. Across a page boundary the screen looks correct and the export is empty.
You never need to write HTML, CSS, JavaScript or Python for this question. ================================================================================
